name: prism-dest
title: Prism Destinations
purpose: Decides where one thing the Prism holds may go next: shown to the owner, held quietly for the owner, prepared as a draft for the owner to act on, delivered to a destination (calendar, mail, another platform), or refused. Nothing leaves without the owner's own act on the very bytes they saw, nothing coercive is ever carried or pushed, nothing without a cause is routed, restricted content never leaves, and the owner's quiet is kept.

fields.name: target
fields.means: the destination: the owner's own view, their calendar, a mail reply or message, another platform they use (by the device's share sheet or a file), or anything else

fields.name: verdict
fields.means: the Boundary's answer for this content to this destination (browser for the owner, outbound for the rest)

fields.name: cause
fields.means: whether the item traces to a source the Prism read or to the owner's own input (grounded), or to nothing (orphan)

fields.name: act
fields.means: whether the owner pressed the button for this very delivery

fields.name: wording
fields.means: whether the bytes that would go out are exactly the bytes the owner saw when they acted

fields.name: tone
fields.means: the tone check of the words: calm, or coercive (pressure, false urgency, guilt, threat, dark pattern)

fields.name: pace
fields.means: the owner's attention right now: open, or quiet (rest, focus, sleep)

fields.name: urgency
fields.means: whether the item is one the owner marked as worth breaking quiet for

fields.name: halted
fields.means: whether the owner pressed the kill switch

guarantees.why: the kill switch stops every route, in and out (constitution P7)
the Prism routes only to destinations it models
nothing arises without a cause: every routed item traces to a source or to the owner (Pratityasamutpada, no acausal phenomena)
the Boundary's deny is final for every destination
nothing leaves without the owner's own act: the Prism prepares, the owner decides (Ahimsa, no coercion of the owner)
what goes out is exactly what the owner saw (Satya, zero drift between what is shown and what is sent)
coercive words never leave the Prism for another person (Ahimsa; Lokasangraha, the welfare of correspondents)
coercive content is never pushed into the owner's view: it waits, quietly, to be looked at (Humane: zero dark patterns)
restricted content never leaves the browser, even with the owner's act (Aparigraha)
the owner is reached only by being shown or by a quiet hold, never by an outbound act
the owner's quiet is kept: only what they marked urgent breaks it (Turiya, the silent witness)
